firm_data.firm_description: A full-service transactional law firm providing counsel to individuals and companies throughout the entertainment and media industries. They represent clients working on both studio and independently financed projects.
notable_facts: The firm represents writers, directors, actors, producers, musicians, composers and authors, as well as production companies, financiers, music publishing companies, sales agents, and motion picture and television studios.

email.subject: AI for Sloss Eckhouse Dasti Haynes LawCo. - built for firms like yours
email.body:
Hi Jacqueline,

Your firm's work across entertainment, media, and new media represents exactly the kind of high-stakes, deal-intensive practice where precision matters most. With 23 attorneys handling studio and independent projects since 1993, you're navigating complexity that demands smart tooling.

I lead business at Lucio, an AI platform built for law firms facing BigLaw demands with leaner teams. We recently raised $5M, and firms across 9 jurisdictions have chosen us over Harvey because we focus on the realities of smaller practices: precision, client trust, and efficiency.

Having completed successful pilots on the East Coast, we're now arriving in New York to meet regional firms. I'd be happy to stop by your office to share how, as ex-lawyers ourselves, we're helping similar firms compete with BigLaw.

Worth 20 minutes?

Vasu
Lucio
